events.name: Code Buster
events.desc: A three-round, two-day solo or duo frontend (HTML/CSS) coding and creative problem solving adventure.

events.name: Red Tech
events.desc: Design and present a tech-based hardware prototype using microcontrollers like Arduino or Raspberry Pi.

events.name: Robo Wars
events.desc: Build a combat robot to push the opposing robot out of the circular arena or flip it over in one-on-one combat.

events.name: Robo Race
events.desc: Design a manually controlled robot to navigate an obstacle-laden race track in the shortest possible time.

events.name: Robo Pick & Place
events.desc: Design a pick-and-place robot to pick up wooden cubes and place them in designated target spots.

events.name: IntelliQuest
events.desc: Develop a creative, practical, and implementable solution to a real-world problem within a 3-hour time limit.

events.name: BrainStorm Battle
events.desc: A dynamic quiz competition testing participants in Science, Engineering, Traditions, GK, and current affairs.

events.name: Circuit Crafter
events.desc: Design, assemble, and demonstrate a working electronic circuit on a breadboard from basic components.

events.name: Electrofix Challenge
events.desc: Identify, troubleshoot, and repair faulty electrical and electronic circuits within the time limit.

events.name: Junkyard Wars
events.desc: Transform scrap and waste materials into innovative engineering models under time constraints.

events.name: AI Quizathon
events.desc: Test your knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts and algorithms.

events.name: EcoAI Challenge
events.desc: Leverage AI to develop smart and sustainable solutions for environmental problems and pollution.

events.name: Project Model Exhibition
events.desc: Present working or demonstrative project models based on Science, Society, and Environment.

events.name: Coding Ladder
events.desc: A competitive coding battle focused on solving DSA problems of increasing difficulty on a PC.

events.name: Web Wizard
events.desc: Build a beautiful and responsive website based on the Technika 6.0 theme under a 5-hour time limit.

events.name: Cyber Shield
events.desc: A Capture The Flag (CTF) cybersecurity challenge covering web security, reverse engineering, and cryptography.

events.name: App Attack
events.desc: Develop a functional mobile application prototype aligning with a provided problem statement.

events.name: Data Dash
events.desc: Solve a dataset-based problem using machine learning, data analytics, and data visualization.

events.name: Design Dash
events.desc: Create an original user interface design on Figma or Adobe XD based on a given problem statement.

events.name: Load Bridging
events.desc: Design and construct a lightweight bridge using ice cream sticks and glue that can withstand maximum load.

2.desc: Themed runway fashion choreography and synchronized ensemble showdown.

2.title: Events Wrap-Up
2.desc: Culmination of all competitive events and final evaluation by judges.

2.title: Valedictory & Prize Distribution
2.desc: Prize distribution, felicitation of champions, and honoring distinguished guests.

2.title: Live Concert
2.desc: Star night musical concert, dynamic DJ performance, and grand festival celebration.
